Content: - Can now press enter in the multiworld name to create the multiworld
- Can now press enter in the slot name to create a slot
- Text Client now treats messages in regards to the item filter differently, view readme for details
- Fixed minor bug with Circle Tracker button
- Added an Error message for if a portrait/emote fails to load
- Fixed background image resizing issue
- Added autoupdater (can be buggy, made the check for updates on start off by default (Settings -> Theme))
- Changed how item message are formated from {{item;game name;item name}} to {{item;\`\`game name\`\`;\`\`item name\`\`}}
- This is to fix games/items that have a `;` in their name for whatever reason
- Added an option to hide timestamps
- PrintJsonMessages are no longer forgotten
- Fixed being able to change the leader client during cooldown
- Added a popup telling you if you have reached the max connected clients
- Hopefully fixed a bug running the Circle Tracker on Linux
- Added a message for if the Circle Tracker doesn't have any text
- Fixed Run on connect popup being broken
- Updated some text about the run on connect command
- Changed how the inventory/location searching works a little in the utilities tab
- Fixed 2 bugs relating to version comparing
- v0.6.0-beta.8 cannot auto-update
- Fixed a bug with the item/location display in utilities
- This is mostly to test the auto updater :3
